neck_side_bending.description: RULA includes neck side-bending in neck posture assessment.

neck_flexion_extension.description: RULA evaluates neck flexion and extension. PostGuard uses its validated prototype classification as posture evidence only.

static_duration.description: A PostGuard prototype duration evidence rule. It must not be interpreted as a standalone RULA risk threshold or automatic risk level.

interaction_policy.description: shoulder_tilt and relative neck_lateral_tilt remain visible as separate evidence, but Risk Evaluation must not automatically add scores simply because both are active.

limitations: PostGuard does not currently measure all body regions required for full RULA.
PostGuard does not currently calculate the official RULA Table A, Table B, or Table C score.
shoulder_tilt is not equivalent to the RULA shoulder-raised adjustment.
PostGuard neck measurements are prototype computer-vision measurements and are not represented as validated anatomical RULA angles.
The 60-second temporal threshold is a PostGuard prototype evidence rule and does not independently define a RULA or clinical risk level.
PostGuard Prototype Risk Level mapping is not enabled in Risk Evaluation Contract v1.1.
